preconditions.expression: head is None or (head.val is not None and 1 <= head.val <= 10**6)
preconditions.description: The input linked list is either empty or its head node has a valid integer value between 1 and 10^6 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in [head] + [node.next for node in [head] if node.next is not None])
preconditions.description: Every node in the linked list has a valid integer value between 1 and 10^6 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(node.val <= node.next.val for node in [head] if node and node.next)
preconditions.description: The linked list is sorted in non-decreasing order (ascending).

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or (return_value.val is not None and 1 <= return_value.val <= 10**6)
postconditions.description: The returned BST root is either empty or its value is a valid integer between 1 and 10^6 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(node.val is not None and 1 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node.left] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node.right])
postconditions.description: Every node in the BST has a valid integer value between 1 and 10^6 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(node.val <= node.left.val if node.left else True for node in [return_value] if node.left) and all(node.val >= node.right.val if node.right else True for node in [return_value] if node.right)
postconditions.description: The BST property holds: for every node, all values in its left subtree are ≤ its value, and all values in its right subtree are ≥ its value.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val in {n.val for n in [head] + [n.next for n in [head] if n.next]} for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node.left] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node.right])
postconditions.description: The BST contains exactly the same values as the input linked list, with no duplicates or omissions.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val <= node.val for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node.left] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node.right]) and all(node.right is None or node.right.val >= node.val for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node.left] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node.right])
postconditions.description: The BST is balanced: the height difference between left and right subtrees of every node is at most 1.
